result:
The design for change 0002 is ready for your review in PR https://github.com/luissiviero/crypto-backtester/pull/10, labelled `sdlc:design-ready`. The gate result is **wait**, because the design gate needs your merge. No flagged concerns are left open, and the review panel took 1 decision for you.

**What the design does**
- **Redirects:** downloads only talk HTTPS to the URL they asked for. A 3xx answer is not followed and shows up as `Vision refused (HTTP 3xx)` or `REST refused (HTTP 3xx)`. Any other URL scheme is refused. Proxies from the environment and the existing timeouts keep working.
- **Datetime bounds:** passing a `datetime` as start or end raises `InvalidRequestError` instead of `TypeError`. The fix also covers `clear_cache`, which had the same crash.
- **Windows tzdata:** `pyproject.toml` adds `tzdata` for Windows only and lists the packages, so `pip install -e .` works. `.gitignore` ignores the `*.egg-info/` folder that install creates.
- **Open questions:** all three are answered the way the intent proposed. No live check of the Binance hosts is needed before the build. A run may not make outbound calls anyway, and a host that redirects would fail visibly as a refused day.

**Decision taken for you:** the version stays at 0.1.0. `tests/test_smoke.py` checks for 0.1.0, and a fix-type change may not edit an existing test, so a bump would have to be a later change. A review comment on the PR overturns this.

**Review:** the adversarial reviewer said continue both times, before and after the panel decision. It classed the plan non-routine because every download goes through the rebuilt HTTP code and the packaging changes. That is why the PR waits for you instead of going straight to the build.

**What only you can do, after this change reaches `main`:**
- In `CLAUDE.md`, change the Setup line to `python -m pip install -e . pytest ruff`. Also update the sentence that says polars is the one runtime dependency, since Windows now also gets `tzdata`.
- In `sdlc.yaml`, change `commands.setup` to the same command.

Changing either line earlier would break the phase jobs, because `pip install -e .` fails until the packaging fix is on `main`. `plan.md` names both lines.

**Not run:** build, test and lint were not run in this phase. The change touches only `spec.md`, `plan.md` and evidence, and the gate leaves those commands to the runner. The Windows test run is yours to do at the deploy gate, since no CI job runs on Windows.

An untracked `CLAUDE.local.md` that I didn't create is sitting in the working tree. I left it alone and it is not in any commit.
